description: UX MIND is a digital design agency. It builds SaaS products, admin dashboards and marketing sites for clients in Europe and the US.
bullets: Led {led.ux-mind} developers on client projects, up to {peak.ux-mind} at a time: estimate every project, decide who takes which task, review code, coach, and act as the clients' technical contact.
Run hiring and recruiting, because the agency has no HR: screen candidates, set the test tasks, interview and onboard. Hired {hired.ux-mind} developers.
Led or built {ledOrBuilt.ux-mind} client projects, from marketing sites to SaaS platforms and admin dashboards.

Set the team's default stack (Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Prisma on PostgreSQL, Better Auth, oRPC, React Hook Form with Zod, Tailwind CSS) and the quality gates new projects start with (Biome, Husky, GitHub Actions, Vitest).
Built client integrations with Stripe, Shopify, Sanity, Twilio, Resend, Mux, Leaflet, Upstash, Arcjet, Sentry, PostHog and the Vercel AI SDK with Gemini.
Designed the studio's technical interview: a 90-minute simulated workday where candidates work real tasks with Claude Code and AI-played teammates, and are graded on judgement instead of recall.
Wrote `ux-mind-helpers`, a zero-dependency toolbox of 8 codemods and lint guards for the agency's projects (import aliases, Tailwind values, React Compiler checks, `.env` sync).
Adopted Claude Code in 08.2025 and wrote the team's conventions for using it.

description: Self-employed client work next to UX MIND: marketing sites and a streaming platform built end to end, plus fixes and hosting for existing sites.
bullets: Built alba.swiss end to end: the first version in 04.2025 and the 09.2026 rebuild, a marketing site with 16 animated sections and a request-an-introduction form.
Built and deployed the Department of Human Dynamics site, a marketing site for an AI research group with structured data for SEO (62 commits).
Built a live-video streaming platform alone: adaptive HLS video, creator profiles with media feeds, English and Dutch with next-intl, a Sanity CMS, and Docker with Nginx on a VPS.
Took over gdd.education: UI polish and bug fixes, a move from Vercel to a VPS, Docker builds, DNS and self-hosted Umami analytics.
